facets.description: optimized_image.rb:145-151 defines downsize twice; the later (from, to, dimensions, opts) version replaces the max_width/max_height version, which becomes dead code
5-arg caller resize_emoji.rb:14 downsize(path, path, 100, 100, opts) now raises ArgumentError (given 5, expected 3..4)
4-arg old-signature calls bind the height to opts, which raises TypeError on opts[:...] or produces bad width-only geometry
The new uploads_controller.rb:67 downsize(..., "80%", ...) call works only because the last definition wins; keeping the 4-arg form would produce invalid geometry
